DROP TABLE "public"."Astro"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Astrologer" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "displayName" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "experienceYears" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "expertise" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isListed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "languages" text[] DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
  "mustChangePassword" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Astrologer_expertise_elem_not_null_0a98fe9c" CHECK (array_position("expertise", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "Astrologer_languages_elem_not_null_d4aa0a00" CHECK (array_position("languages", NULL) IS NULL)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AvailabilityException" (
  "astrologerId" text NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "endTime" time(0),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" time(0),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "AvailabilityException_kind_check_f80667a4" CHECK ("kind" IN ('blocked', 'extra'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AvailabilityRule" (
  "astrologerId" text NOT NULL,
  "endTime" time(0) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" time(0) NOT NULL,
  "weekday" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Blog" (
  "astrologerId" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "publishedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "status" text DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Blog_status_check_e888e82e" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'published'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BlogComment" (
  "blogId" text NOT NULL,
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BlogLike" (
  "blogId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("blogId", "userId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Booking" (
  "astrologerId" text NOT NULL,
  "astrologerJoinedAt" timestamptz(3),
  "callMode" text NOT NULL,
  "callType" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "holdExpiresAt" timestamptz(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "pricePaise" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "usedCredit" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "userJoinedAt" timestamptz(3),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_callMode_check_a73543f2" CHECK ("callMode" IN ('in_app', 'phone')),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_callType_check_b6916e36" CHECK ("callType" IN ('normal', 'urgent', 'subscription')),
  CONSTRAINT "Booking_status_check_7dcd0cb1" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending_payment', 'confirmed', 'completed', 'missed', 'expired'))
)

precheck.description: Check whether Booking_no_overlap still needs to be added
precheck.sql:
SELECT NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM pg_constraint
              WHERE conname = 'Booking_no_overlap'
                AND conrelid = '"public"."Booking"'::regclass
            ) AS ok

execute.sql:
ALTER TABLE "Booking" ADD CONSTRAINT "Booking_no_overlap"
              EXCLUDE USING gist ("astrologerId" WITH =, tstzrange("startsAt", "endsAt") WITH &&)
              WHERE (status IN ('pending_payment', 'confirmed'))

postcheck.sql:
SELECT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM pg_constraint
              WHERE conname = 'Booking_no_overlap'
                AND conrelid = '"public"."Booking"'::regclass
            ) AS ok

CREATE TABLE "public"."Owner" (
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Payment" (
  "amountPaise" int4 NOT NULL,
  "bookingId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "purpose" text NOT NULL,
  "razorpayOrderId" text NOT NULL,
  "razorpayPaymentId" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Payment_purpose_check_e6409c14" CHECK ("purpose" IN ('normal_call', 'urgent_call', 'subscription_pack')),
  CONSTRAINT "Payment_status_check_348270cb" CHECK ("status" IN ('created', 'paid', 'failed', 'refunded'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Session" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "subjectId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Session_role_check_d574a543" CHECK ("role" IN ('user', 'astrologer', 'owner'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Settings" (
  "id" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "normalDurationMin" int4 DEFAULT 15 NOT NULL,
  "normalPricePaise" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "subscriptionCallsPerPack" int4 DEFAULT 4 NOT NULL,
  "subscriptionDurationMin" int4 DEFAULT 15 NOT NULL,
  "subscriptionPricePaise" int4 DEFAULT 99900 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "urgentDurationMin" int4 DEFAULT 15 NOT NULL,
  "urgentPricePaise" int4 DEFAULT 30000 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WebhookEvent" (
  "eventId" text NOT NULL,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("eventId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "birthDate" date,
  "birthPlace" text,
  "birthTime" time(0),
  "createdAt" timestamptz(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "googleSub" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "subscriptionCredits" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_gender_check_f90b1c49" CHECK ("gender" IN ('male', 'female', 'other'))
)
